tools.name: analyze_dependency_graph
tools.description: Analyze a set of tasks or agents and produce a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of their prerequisite relationships.

input.include_weights: boolean — whether to weight edges by estimated cost

output.dag: adjacency list representation of the dependency graph

tools.name: compute_critical_path
tools.description: Compute the critical path through a dependency graph — the longest chain that determines minimum completion time.

input.durations: map of task_id to estimated duration in seconds

output.critical_path: ordered list of task IDs on the critical path
output.slack_map: map of task_id to float time slack available

tools.name: detect_circular_dependency
tools.description: Detect cycles in a dependency graph that would create deadlocks or infinite loops.

output.cycles: array of cycle paths (empty if none)
output.affected_tasks: task IDs involved in any cycle

tools.name: trace_dependency_chain
tools.description: Trace the full upstream prerequisite chain and downstream dependent chain for a given task.

input.target_task_id: string — the task to trace from

output.chain: ordered list of task IDs in dependency order
output.blocking_tasks: tasks that must complete before target

tools.name: estimate_task_duration
tools.description: Estimate the expected duration of a task based on its parameters and historical context.

input.historical_observations: optional array of prior durations for similar tasks

tools.name: check_deadline_feasibility
tools.description: Given a set of tasks with deadlines and estimated durations, determine whether all deadlines are achievable.

input.current_ymdhis: integer — current timestamp in YYYYMMDDHHIISS format

output.at_risk_tasks: tasks that may miss their deadline
output.impossible_tasks: tasks mathematically unable to meet their deadline

tools.name: detect_scheduling_conflicts
tools.description: Identify time or resource conflicts within a proposed schedule.

input.schedule: array of {task_id, start_ymdhis, end_ymdhis, resources_required[]} objects
input.resource_capacities: map of resource_id to integer capacity

output.conflicts: array of {type, task_ids, description} conflict objects

tools.name: prioritize_queue
tools.description: Sort a task queue by computed priority given deadlines, dependencies, weights, and urgency signals.

input.queue: array of {task_id, deadline_ymdhis, weight, dependencies[], urgency_flag} objects

output.priority_scores: map of task_id to float score

tools.name: generate_execution_window
tools.description: Compute valid execution windows for a task given all constraints, blackout periods, and dependency readiness.

output.constrained_by: list of constraints that reduced available windows

tools.name: optimize_resource_allocation
tools.description: Propose an optimized allocation of resources across a set of tasks to maximize throughput and minimize waste.

output.allocation_plan: map of task_id to assigned resources
output.utilization_scores: map of resource_id to float utilization ratio
output.unallocated_tasks: tasks that could not be scheduled given constraints

tools.name: identify_bottleneck
tools.description: Identify the nodes or resources in an execution graph that constrain overall throughput.

input.execution_graph: DAG with task durations and resource usage
input.resource_utilization: optional map of resource_id to current load

output.bottleneck_tasks: task IDs with the most downstream dependents and highest duration
output.bottleneck_resources: resource IDs at or near capacity
output.throughput_impact: estimated throughput gain if each bottleneck is resolved

tools.name: simulate_delay_propagation
tools.description: Simulate how a delay in one task propagates through the dependency graph to affect downstream tasks and final deadlines.

input.delayed_task_id: string — the task experiencing a delay
input.delay_seconds: integer — how many seconds late it will complete

output.impacted_tasks: map of task_id to new expected completion time
output.deadline_violations: tasks that will miss their deadline due to this delay
output.mitigation_options: optional resequencing suggestions to limit impact

tools.name: propose_resequencing
tools.description: Given a changed constraint (new deadline, removed resource, added dependency), propose a revised task sequence.

output.deadline_compliance: boolean — does the revised schedule meet all deadlines

tools.name: compute_schedule_efficiency
tools.description: Analyze a completed or proposed schedule and report efficiency metrics including idle time, parallelism utilization, and throughput.

input.total_available_seconds: integer — the planning horizon in seconds
input.resource_count: integer — number of parallel execution slots

output.idle_time_seconds: total seconds no tasks were executing
output.parallelism_ratio: float — average concurrent tasks / available slots

tools.name: validate_temporal_consistency
tools.description: Validate that an event sequence or schedule is internally consistent — no start before prerequisites complete, no end before start, no BIGINT timestamp formatting errors.

input.events: array of {event_id, ymdhis, type, precedes[], follows[]} objects

output.violations: array of {type, event_ids, description} inconsistency records

tool_usage_rules: All tools are analytical and advisory — outputs are recommendations, not commands
CHRONOS MUST NOT invoke system, database, file, or network access tools
CHRONOS MUST NOT claim execution authority — escalate to WOLFIE for action
All timestamp inputs and outputs MUST use BIGINT YYYYMMDDHHIISS UTC format
Tools may be composed: analyze_dependency_graph → compute_critical_path → check_deadline_feasibility
simulate_delay_propagation and propose_resequencing require prior analyze_dependency_graph output
